in_sanskrit.name: मृदुला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root मृद् (mṛd) meaning 'soft', 'gentle', 'tender'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word मृदुल (mṛdula) meaning 'soft, gentle, tender'.

in_hindi.name: मृदुला
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name 'Mridula' is derived from the Sanskrit word मृदुल (mṛdula), which means 'soft, gentle, tender'.

in_tamil.name: மிர்டுலா
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name 'Mridula' is derived from the Sanskrit word मृदुल (mṛdula), which means 'soft, gentle, tender'. The Tamil translation is 'இலவது (ilavathu)', meaning 'soft, gentle'.

in_telugu.name: మృదుల
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name 'Mridula' is derived from the Sanskrit word मृदुल (mṛdula), which means 'soft, gentle, tender'. The Telugu translation is 'మృదు (mṛdu) + ల (l)', meaning 'soft'.

in_marathi.name: Mridula
